card.name: Bible references to the book of Acts
card.fires_on: Numbers, colons and spaces right after the book name Acts in Bible citations, plus the word of in titles like Acts of Saint. It also fires on chapter or verse digits in lists of citations.

modes.label: After Acts
modes.description: The space, chapter digit or colon that follows the book name Acts in a scripture citation.
modes.example: Cornelius and his group were the first Gentiles received into the new covenant (Acts<< >>10).

modes.label: Inside citation lists
modes.description: Verse or chapter digits within a run of scripture references, often in a string that includes Acts.

modes.label: Acts of titles
modes.description: The word of after Acts in the title of an apocryphal work.
modes.example: In the Apocryphal Acts<< of>> Saint Ignatius of Antioch
